name: module-listener-decl-test-9b9489d763/module-listener-declaration-v
spec_references: Expressions: [New expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_6.8.2); object constructor expressions are absent from the supported expression list
Object/class definitions: Only `client`, `service` and `isolated` `object-type-quals` / `class-type-quals` are supported
reason: The declarations submodule exercises listener declarations initialized both from class instances and from an anonymous object constructor. Listener declarations and class construction are listed as supported, but the `listener lsn = object { ... }` initializer requires an object constructor expression, which is not in the positive supported-expression list. This essential construct makes the whole case a feature gap.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous object constructor expression used as a listener initializer
test_design_notes: The supplied main function is empty and imports no declarations submodule; the listener cases reside in that submodule. No explicit behavioral assertions are supplied.
